verbatim: Roctavian has a wholesale acquisition cost, or WAC, of $2.9 million for the average patient for this one-time, single-dose treatment.

notes: BioMarin disclosed the $2.9 million WAC on FDA approval (2023-06-29) in its press release and investor call; the BioMarin press-release URL could not be located (404) and trade-press pages returned 403, so the figure is taken from a secondary source snippet. verbatim: Following FDA approval, the Company activated its U.S.-based salesforce and communicated that ROCTAVIAN is expected to be available for commercial use in August.
source_doc: BioMarin 8-K Ex-99.1, BioMarin Announces Strong Second Quarter 2023 Results and Record Breaking Revenues for the First Half of 2023 (2023-07-31)

verbatim: Today in Germany, the second commercial patient was treated with ROCTAVIAN.

verbatim: the company announced its plan to pursue options to divest ROCTAVIAN, including exploring out-licensing opportunities.

notes: Also: BioMarin plans to continue to make ROCTAVIAN commercially available in the U.S., Italy and Germany until next steps are finalized; The company will continue to provide support and monitoring for people treated with ROCTAVIAN.

verbatim: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. today announced that it will voluntarily remove ROCTAVIAN from the market.
source_doc: BioMarin company statement, BioMarin Voluntarily Withdraws ROCTAVIAN (valoctocogene roxaparvovec-rvox) from the Market (2026-02-23)
notes: Statement: unable to identify a qualified buyer; This decision is not related to ROCTAVIAN's efficacy or safety profile; The company will maintain its commercial patient support program and honor existing outcomes-based agreements with payers; BioMarin is committed to supporting individuals who have already been treated with ROCTAVIAN and will continue to provide ongoing monitoring and follow-up care.

verbatim: Following the company's October announcement to explore options to divest ROCTAVIAN, BioMarin undertook a comprehensive effort to identify a potential buyer. Despite these efforts, BioMarin was unable to identify a qualified buyer and has made the decision to voluntarily withdraw ROCTAVIAN from the market.
source_doc: BioMarin 8-K Ex-99.1, BioMarin Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-year 2025 Financial and Operating Results (2026-02-23)
notes: $240 million during the quarter: $119 million inventory write-off in Cost of Sales and $118 million long-lived asset impairments in SG&A. 2026 guidance folds ROCTAVIAN into Other Revenues of $100-$125 million (with KUVAN and royalties).

verbatim: the company would continue to make ROCTAVIAN available to the U.S. community through the end of May. It will also be available in Italy and Germany on the same timeline.
